Lane 07 · Cron Substrate — captain brief
Synthesis for the strategist. Full evidence trail lives in the detective report; this is the compressed, table-forward view.
Synthesis note: The detective found the scheduler itself sound — the failure is entirely at the consumer boundary, where two independent readers make the same wrong assumption about what job presence proves.

Axiom under partial violation
"A cron job proves a durable heartbeat" is assumed by two consumers and true for neither. The gate and the handoff writer both read job PRESENCE as proof of job PERSISTENCE.
Lane verdict
appropriate_but_undernotified

The scheduler itself is sound and well-documented. The failure is entirely at the consumer boundary: nothing downstream distinguishes 'never armed' from 'armed and silently expired.'
